liquidity.notes: USDT escrowed across 82 fiat markets (up to 100 ads per market, 5-page adaptive depth).

volume_30d_usd.notes: Binance does not separately disclose P2P volume

observed_spread_bps.notes: No USD market ad in the top-20 accepts a $1k single-match trade with enough escrowed USDT.

markets.notes: Top 10 deepest markets (by USDT depth in top-20 ad slice), filtered to those with FX mids available.

depth_composition.notes: Per-fiat share of USDT escrow observed in the top-20 BUY ad slice across 82 fiat markets. Snapshot, not a window — Binance doesn't publish historical volume.

network_health.notes: Maker-reputation aggregates across distinct advertisers seen in the top-20 slice of every probed market. Snapshot of currently-posting makers, not a 30d window.
